route.passenger_note: 2 adults + 1 child aged 12. A 12-year-old pays adult fare, so the search uses 3 adults.
route.max_duration_note: Applies to each direction. With 960 (16 h) Google returned no Qatar options at all, although Qatar outbound flights take 15-16 h; the return legs via Doha are probably longer.
